translationRepairs: He was promoted in succession to grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Guard, prefect of Bingzhou, great protector of Andong, and commander-in-chief of all circuits.
He was promoted in succession to grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Guard, prefect of Bingzhou, great protector of Anbei, and commander-in-chief of all circuits.
安北大都護 is the Anbei (Pacifying the North) protectorate, not Andong.
Prince Bian Yong was demoted to prefect of Qinzhou; Xiao Zhizhong to prefect of Xuzhou; Wei Siliz to prefect of Songzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Jiangzhou; and Cui Shi to prefect of Huazhou.
Prince Bian Yong was demoted to prefect of Qinzhou; Xiao Zhizhong to prefect of Xuzhou; Wei Sili to prefect of Songzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Jiangzhou; and Cui Shi to prefect of Huazhou.
韋嗣立 is Wei Sili; draft misspelled the name.

Wei Siliz and Xiao Zhizhong were appointed secretariat directors; Zhao Yanzhao vice secretary of the secretariat; and Cui Shi vice minister of the civil service—all as Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

Wei Sili and Xiao Zhizhong were appointed secretariat directors; Zhao Yanzhao vice secretary of the secretariat; and Cui Shi vice minister of the civil service—all as Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
韋嗣立 is Wei Sili; draft misspelled the name.

On renxu Xiao Zhizhong was demoted to prefect of Jinzhou; Wei Sili to prefect of Xuzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Songzhou; and Zhang Xi to prefect of Jiangzhou.
韋嗣立 is Wei Sili; draft misspelled the name.

Xuanzong then joined Princess Taiping's son Xue Chongjian, Palace Wardrobe Attendant Wang Chongye, the princess household registrar Wang Shiqian, Chaoyi captain Liu Youqiu, park director-general Zhong Shaojing, senior commander Ma Sizong, commanders of the Ten Thousand Cavalry Guo Fushun and Li Xianfeng, the Daoist Feng Chucheng, and the monk Puyun to settle on a plan to suppress the uprising.

Xuanzong then joined Princess Taiping's son Xue Chongjian, Palace Wardrobe Attendant Wang Chongye, the princess household registrar Wang Shiqian, Chaoyi captain Liu Youqiu, park director-general Zhong Shaojing, senior commander Ma Sizong, commanders of the Ten Thousand Cavalry Ge Fushun and Li Xianfu, the Daoist Feng Chucheng, and the monk Purun to settle on a plan to suppress the uprising.
葛福順 is Ge Fushun; 李仙鳧 is Li Xianfu; 普潤 is Purun.

That night he led Youqiu and the others into the imperial park; Fushun and Xianfeng attacked the Xuanwu Gate with ten thousand horsemen and beheaded Left Forest of Plumes general Wei Bo and commandant Gao Song as a warning.

That night he led Youqiu and the others into the imperial park; Fushun and Xianfu attacked the Xuanwu Gate with ten thousand horsemen and beheaded Left Forest of Plumes general Wei Bo and commandant Gao Song as a warning.
Xue Ne, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was appointed grand commander of the Liangzhou frontier army, with Yang Zhi, military governor of Liangzhou, as deputy;
Xue Ne, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was appointed grand commander of the Liangzhou frontier army, with Yang Zhiyi, military governor of Liangzhou, as deputy;
Guo Qianjin, grand general of the Right Guard, was appointed grand commander of the Shuofang frontier army, with Wang Jun, chief administrator of Bingzhou, as deputy, to guard against the Turks.
Guo Qianjin, grand general of the Right Guard, was appointed grand commander of the Shuozhou frontier army, with Wang Jun, chief administrator of Bingzhou, as deputy, to guard against the Turks.
朔州 is Shuozhou prefecture, not Shuofang.
In the tenth month on xinyou the Xi barbarians raided the frontier; Li Xuandao, general of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard, attacked them.
In the tenth month on xinyou the Xizhou barbarians raided the frontier; Li Xuandao, general of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard, attacked them.
巂州蠻 are the barbarians of Xizhou (巂州), not the Xi (奚) people.
On guiyou Sun Renshen, military governor of Songzhou, fought Tibet and defeated them.
On guiyou Sun Renxian, military governor of Songzhou, fought Tibet and defeated them.
On guiyou Hao Lingxian, sub-commander of the Great Martial Army, killed the Turkic khagan Mojilian.
On guiyou Hao Lingquan, sub-commander of the Great Martial Army, killed the Turkic khagan Mochuo.
郝靈佺 is Hao Lingquan; 默啜 is Mochuo.
On bingxu Mei Shuqing of Annan rebelled and was put to death.
On bingxu Mei Shuluan of Annan rebelled and was put to death.
The emperor's sons Ti, Wei, Yun, Ze, Qing, Yan, Mu, Yi, and Yi were enfeoffed as Princes of Guang, Yi, Ying, Yong, Shou, Yan, Sheng, Ji, and Ji.
The emperor's sons Ju, Wei, Yun, Ze, Qing, Hui, Mu, and Yi were enfeoffed as Princes of Guang, Yi, Ying, Yong, Shou, Yan, Sheng, and Ji.
Source names eight sons (涺 Ju, 濰, 澐, 澤, 清, 洄 Hui, 沐, 溢) and eight princedoms; draft misread 涺 and 洄 and duplicated Yi/Ji.
In the ninth month on bingzi Tibet raided Guazhou and captured Prefect Tian Xianxian.
In the ninth month on bingzi Tibet raided Guazhou and captured Prefect Tian Yuanxian.
In the first month of the fifteenth year on xinchou Wang Junji, commissioner of the Hexi and Longyou circuits, fought the Tibetans at Qinghai and defeated them.
In the first month of the fifteenth year on xinchou Wang Junchuo, commissioner of the Hexi and Longyou circuits, fought the Tibetans at Qinghai and defeated them.
On gengshen the Uyghurs raided Ganzhou and Wang Junji was killed.
On gengshen the Uyghurs raided Ganzhou and Wang Junchuo was killed.
In the second month of the seventeenth year on dingmao Zhang Shensi, military governor of Xi Prefecture, captured the Kunming cities of Yunnan and Salt City.
In the second month of the seventeenth year on dingmao Zhang Shensu, military governor of Xi Prefecture, captured the Kunming cities of Yunnan and Salt City.
In the first month of the nineteenth year Wang Maoqiu, vice prefect of Rang Prefecture, was killed.
In the first month of the nineteenth year Wang Maozhong, vice prefect of Rang Prefecture, was killed.
On jiayin Han Xiu, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Yellow Gate Vice Director and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
On jiayin Han Xiu, Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Yellow Gate Vice Director and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
尚書右丞 is the Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, not a Secretariat post.

In the ninth month on renwu princes were enfeoffed: Min as Prince of Xin, Ci as Prince of Yi, Cui as Prince of Chen, Cheng as Prince of Feng, Hui as Prince of Heng, Xuan as Prince of Liang, and Tao as Prince of Shen.

In the ninth month on renwu princes were enfeoffed: Mian as Prince of Xin, Ci as Prince of Yi, Cui as Prince of Chen, Cheng as Prince of Feng, Hui as Prince of Heng, Xuan as Prince of Liang, and Tao as Prince of Shen.
In the tenth month on yihai Prince Bian Jin died.
In the tenth month on yihai Prince Bian Jing died.
On renyin Pei Yaoji and Zhang Jiuling were removed from office.
On renyin Pei Yaoqing and Zhang Jiuling were removed from office.
In the first month of the twenty-sixth year on jiaxu Chen Sitang, prefect of Chaozhou, plotted rebellion and was put to death.
In the first month of the twenty-sixth year on jiaxu Chen Siting, prefect of Chaozhou, plotted rebellion and was put to death.
On renzi Zhang Qiu Jianqiong, military commissioner of Yizhou, defeated Tibet and captured Anrong City.
On renzi Zhangqiu Jianqiong, marshal of Yizhou, defeated Tibet and captured Anrong City.
章仇 is the compound surname Zhangqiu; 司馬 is marshal, not military commissioner.

The palace attendant was renamed Left Minister, the secretariat director Right Minister, the Eastern Capital Eastern Capital, the Northern Capital Northern Capital, prefectures commanderies, and prefects governors.

The palace attendant was renamed Left Minister, the secretariat director Right Minister, the Eastern Capital (Dongdu) Dongjing, the Northern Capital (Beidu) Beijing, prefectures commanderies, and prefects governors.
東都為東京，北都為北京: the renamed forms were collapsed in the draft.
On gengzi Wang Han, commissioner of the Hexi circuit, captured the Tibetan Fishing Sea and Mobile Campaign armies.
On gengzi Wang Chui, commissioner of the Hexi circuit, captured the Tibetan Fishing Sea and Mobile Campaign armies.

In the third month on renzi sacrifice was offered at the Mysterious Origin Abbey; the Great Sage's grandfather Zhou Shangyu Imperial Grandee Jing was posthumously titled Primordial Great Emperor; Gao Yao was posthumously titled Virtuous Bright Emperor; and Liang Wuzhao King was posthumously titled Flourishing Sage Emperor.

In the third month on renzi sacrifice was offered at the Mysterious Origin Abbey; the Great Sage Ancestor's father Jing, Superior Grand Master of Zhou was posthumously titled Primordial Great Emperor; Gao Yao was posthumously titled Virtuous Bright Emperor; and King Wuzhao of Liang was posthumously titled Flourishing Sage Emperor.
大聖祖父周上御大夫敬: father of the Great Sage Ancestor, Jing, Zhou superior grand master; 涼武昭王 is King Wuzhao of Liang.
On dingchou Pei Dunfu, chief magistrate of Henan, Liu Tongsheng, prefect of Jinling commandery, and Liu Juxi, prefect of Nanhai commandery, attacked Wu Lingguang.
On dingchou Pei Dunfu, chief magistrate of Henan, Liu Tongsheng, prefect of Jinling commandery, and Liu Julin, prefect of Nanhai commandery, attacked Wu Lingguang.
In the seventh month Wei Jian, prefect of Kuoji commandery, and Huangfu Weiming, prefect of Bochuan commandery, were killed.
In the seventh month Wei Jian, prefect of Kuocang commandery, and Huangfu Weiming, prefect of Bochuan commandery, were killed.
In the eleventh month on dingsi the emperor visited the estate of Supervising Censor Yang Zhao.
In the eleventh month on dingsi the emperor visited the estate of Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Zhao.
御史中丞 is Vice Censor-in-Chief.
On dingyou Li Linfu was additionally appointed deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army and deputy great protector of Andong.
On dingyou Li Linfu was additionally appointed deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army and deputy great protector of Anbei.
In the fourth month on yiyou Wang Xiao, director of the revenue bureau, and Xing Zan of the capital plotted rebellion and were put to death.
In the fourth month on yiyou Wang Han, director of the revenue bureau, and Xing Zai of the capital plotted rebellion and were put to death.
王銲 is Wang Han; 邢縡 is Xing Zai.
Li Linfu was removed as deputy great protector of Andong.
Li Linfu was removed as deputy great protector of Anbei.
In the third month Geshu Han and Wang Han, commissioners of the Longyou and Hexi circuits, defeated Tibet and recovered the nine bends of the Yellow River's source.
In the third month Geshu Han, commissioner of the Longyou and Hexi circuits, defeated Tibet and recovered the nine bends of the Yellow River's source.
Source names only 哥舒翰; "Wang Han" is spurious.
He Qiannian, general of Fanyang, killed Hedong Commissioner Yang Guangbi.
He Qiannian, general of Fanyang, killed Hedong Commissioner Yang Guanghui.

Guo Ziyi, prefect of Jiuyuan commandery, was appointed deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army; Wang Chengye, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was appointed chief magistrate of Taiyuan; Zhang Jieren, minister of the court of imperial stud, was appointed Henan frontier commissioner; and Cheng Qianli was appointed chief administrator of Shangdang commandery—all to attack An Lushan.

On xinmao he captured Chenliu commandery, seized Prefect Guo Na, and Zhang Jieren was killed.
On xinmao he captured Chenliu commandery, seized Prefect Guo Na, and Zhang Jieran was killed.
On bingchen Feng Changqing fought An Lushan at Yingzigu and suffered defeat.
On bingshen Feng Changqing fought An Lushan at Yingzigu and suffered defeat.
On dingyou he captured the Eastern Capital; the acting prefect Li Qian, Censor-in-Chief Lu Yi, and aide Jiang Qing were killed.
On dingyou he captured the Eastern Capital; the acting prefect Li Cheng, Vice Censor-in-Chief Lu Yi, and aide Jiang Qing were killed.
李憕 is Li Cheng; 御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief.
That month Li Sui, prefect of Jinan commandery; Jia Ben, captain of Shanfu; and Shang Heng of Puyang raised troops to attack An Lushan.
On renzi Li Sui, prefect of Jinan commandery; Jia Ben, captain of Shanfu; and Shang Heng of Puyang raised troops to attack An Lushan.
That month Yan Zhenqing, prefect of Pingyuan commandery; Lu Quancheng, prefect of Raoyang commandery; and Li Zheng, military commissioner, raised troops to attack An Lushan.
That month Yan Zhenqing, prefect of Pingyuan commandery; Lu Quancheng, prefect of Raoyang commandery; and Li Zheng, marshal, raised troops to attack An Lushan.
In the first month of the fifteenth year on yimao Li Zhi, heir to Prince Wu of the Eastern Capital, raised troops to attack An Lushan.
In the first month of the fifteenth year on yimao Li Zhi, governor of Dongping commandery and heir Prince of Wu, raised troops to attack An Lushan.
東平郡太守嗣吳王祗: governor of Dongping, not "Eastern Capital".
On jiazi Lu Hui, prefect of Nanyang commandery, was appointed Nanyang commissioner and led troops of Lingnan, Qianzhong, and the eastern mountain circuit to camp at Yexian.
On jiazi Lu Jiong, prefect of Nanyang commandery, was appointed Nanyang commissioner and led troops of Lingnan, Qianzhong, and the eastern mountain circuit to camp at Yexian.
In the fifth month on dingsi Lu Hui fought An Lushan at the Zhi River, suffered defeat, and fled to Nanyang.
In the fifth month on dingsi Lu Jiong fought An Lushan at the Zhi River, suffered defeat, and fled to Nanyang.
On dingchou An Qingxu raided Tong Pass and Geshu Han defeated him.
On yichou An Qingxu raided Tong Pass and Geshu Han defeated him.
On bingwu Lai Tian, senior mentor of the crown prince, was appointed prefect of Yingchuan commandery and additionally pacification commissioner.
On bingwu Lai Zhen, senior mentor of the crown prince, was appointed prefect of Yingchuan commandery and additionally pacification commissioner.
On dingyou the court halted at Mawei; Chen Xuanli, grand general of the Left Dragon Martial Army, killed Yang Guozhong, Supervising Censor Wei Fangjin, and Minister of Ceremonies Yang Xuan.
On dingyou the court halted at Mawei; Chen Xuanli, grand general of the Left Dragon Martial Army, killed Yang Guozhong, Censor-in-Chief Wei Fangjin, and Minister of Ceremonies Yang Xuan.

On dingmao the crown prince was made commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven, supreme over the Shuofang, Hedong, Hebei, and Pinglu commissioners; Pei Mian, censor-in-chief, and Liu Zhi, military commissioner of Longxi commandery, served as deputies.

On dingmao the crown prince was made commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven, supreme over the Shuofang, Hedong, Hebei, and Pinglu commissioners; Pei Mian, vice censor-in-chief, and Liu Zhi, marshal of Longxi commandery, served as deputies.
御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief; 司馬 is marshal.

Prince Lin of Yong was made commissioner of the southeastern mountain, Qianzhong, and Jiangnan western circuits; Prince Qi of Sheng was made military governor of Guangling commandery and commissioner of the Jiangnan eastern and Huainan circuits; and Prince Gong of Feng was made military governor of Wuwei commandery and commissioner of the Hexi, Longyou, Andong, and Beiting circuits.
